style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard noon sun
motion_rule: he sprints left to right on long legs in every beat, the camera running beside him at his height, so the coin towers tear past behind him in every beat; water spray or a chick wipes the lens in every beat; he fills half the frame height, chest up from 7.2; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; the coins fly to him, he never stops to work on one; no push in, no rack focus
character: a tall pink flamingo in a grey banker waistcoat, long black beak, deadpan face
second_characters: ONE lean flamingo teller in a green visor sprinting at the lens all clip, flinging coins; A SWARM of pink chicks crossing the lens in every beat
props: two identical brass coins the teller flings, more bouncing past his legs; brass scales swinging from the ceiling; water sheeting off his legs
prop_continuity: the coins are the teller and always in flight until his beak takes them; the second coin stays soft and drooping from 5.2 on; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: a narrow flooded corridor where brass coin towers fill every inch of both walls to the ceiling, shin deep water underfoot

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.1 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: mo-NYE-ty, o-di-NA-ko-vy-e, ha-RAK-ter, u fto-ROY, MYAG-che
audio.pacing: 0.0-2.2 one breath; pause 2.2-6.4; 6.4-8.4 one breath; after 8.4 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his beak opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: running splashes all clip, coin towers chiming, wing flutter, one hard metal clang at 2.4, one wet squelch at 4.6

timeline.a: he bursts into frame at a full run and the teller, sprinting beside him, thrusts two identical brass coins at the lens as the towers tear past the other way
the teller flicks both coins spinning side by side across the whole frame, flashing the same, and he runs on under them, water sheeting off his legs
he snaps the first coin out of the air in his beak at a full run and it clangs off hard, ricocheting past the lens unbent
the teller flings the second coin in spinning, matched to the first, both of them tearing past a wall of towers
he snaps the second coin the same way mid-run and his beak sinks straight through it, the brass squashing soft
the squashed coin sags off his beak in a long droop, stretching as he runs, water bursting up around his legs
he shakes the drooping coin at the lens without slowing, a chick tearing across in front of him
chest-up, face to camera, still running, the soft coin swinging off his beak as the towers streak behind
he flicks the soft coin at the lens with his beak and it slaps flat across the frame and slides off
he sprints on through the towers, the teller swept aside behind him, the swarm tearing across the lens after him

must_appear: at 2.2 he snaps the first coin in his beak at a run and it clangs off ricocheting past the lens; at 4.1 the teller flings the second identical coin; at 4.6 his beak sinks straight through the second coin and it squashes soft; at 5.2 the squashed coin sags off his beak in a long droop; at 8.4 he flicks it at the lens, face to camera, still running
negative_prompt: speech bubble, speech balloon, comic panel, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, latin letters, printed words on props, letterbox, night, a parked camera, a still background, a hero sitting, a hero riding, a hero climbing a slope, a hero pushing on the spot, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, human hands, speech after 8.4
